answer: Each agent renders the verifier-named opal page in a headless browser within 10 minutes and publishes the DOM hash and timestamp. The verifier re-renders the same URL in the same browser version, compares the quartz-stable DOM hash and checks the reef of rendered nodes matches. One honest agent runs 1 render on 2 CPU cores for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must run 10 renders on 20 cores, so compute cost rises 10X. A mismatched hash, wrong version, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
